provenance.author: Paignia numerical-oracle lane, 2026-11-15
provenance.derivation: Original rational examples and explicit primal/dual certificates; no optimizer output or implementation copied.

assumptions.coordinates: Two players, complete rational matrices A and B. Joint z is flattened row-major. No probability normalization or payoff imputation.
assumptions.incentives: Cz>=0: for each recommended row i and alternative k, sum_j z_ij*(A_ij-A_kj)>=0; analogously for each recommended column j and alternative l. Row constraints first in increasing (i,k), then column constraints in increasing (j,l); self deviations omitted.
assumptions.residuals: weighted_max_gain=max(0,max(-Cz)); conditional gains divide each negative incentive slack by its positive recommendation mass. Zero-mass recommendations have no conditional ratio and are recorded as null.
assumptions.objective: Maximize the explicitly supplied linear c^T z. These examples choose A+B; this synthetic choice is not a production objective default or a consumer valuation policy.
assumptions.optimality_proof: With lambda>=0 and d=upper_bound*1-c-C^T*lambda>=0, any feasible z satisfies c^T z<=upper_bound. Feasible witness equality proves optimality without running an LP solver.
assumptions.tolerance: 0, exact rational arithmetic. No production status or tolerance semantics are defined.

optimal_cases.proof: Incentives are -2*z00+z01, 2*z10-z11, -2*z00+z10, 2*z01-z11. Adding 3/4 of constraints 1 and 3 to the objective gives (21/2)*(z01+z10+z11)<=21/2. The stated joint attains 21/2. Pure Nash off-diagonals have welfare 9; the interior Nash product has welfare 28/3.
Pure dominant-action profile is obedient and attains the largest cell objective, 4. Unused recommendations have mass zero and impose zero weighted constraints, not division by zero.
The matching-pennies product on the first two columns is obedient; the dominated third column is never recommended. Every cell objective is at most zero.
One possible outcome and no deviation constraints; objective -7 is retained, never replaced by zero.
